summary: Ran 17 backend integration tests (pytest) + Playwright E2E across home/browse/login/auction detail/bid/watchlist/admin/create-auction pages. Backend: 13/17 passing. Frontend: core flows all work (auth, browse, filter, bid placement with live UI update, watchlist toggle, admin dashboard, seller create-auction form loads). Found 3 real backend bugs (feedback POST 500, brute-force lockout bypassable via load-balanced ingress IPs, GET /api/ returns 404 due to route registration order). Real-time bidding via Socket.IO verified: placed bid in UI, current_bid updated from $100 -> $110 in place.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - ObjectId serialization error. Code `return {"id": str(res.inserted_id), **doc.items()}` spreads the inserted doc which motor mutates to include `_id: ObjectId`. FastAPI can't serialize ObjectId. Fix: exclude _id from spread (e.g. {**{k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k != '_id'}}). Same anti-pattern likely present in POST /api/categories (line 529).

Brute-force lockout is BYPASSABLE. `check_lockout` identifier is `{request.client.host}:{email}`, but behind kubernetes ingress requests are load-balanced across multiple ingress pods (observed 10.219.2.4 and 10.219.2.7), so counters never reach 5 for a single identifier. After 7 wrong-password attempts we still got 401 instead of 429. Fix: use only email as identifier (or read X-Forwarded-For), and enable ProxyHeadersMiddleware.

minor.issue: Returns 404. The @api.get('/') root route is declared AFTER fastapi_app.include_router(api) on line 977, so it is not registered. Move include_router below the route definition or add root route earlier.
Same _id spread pattern as feedback (line 529). Will 500 if invoked (untested — only admin can invoke).

issues: Uses browser-native datetime-local pickers instead of shadcn calendar component — inconsistent with the modern marketplace design vibe. Consider replacing with shadcn <Calendar> + <Popover>.

action_items: Fix POST /api/feedback ObjectId leak (exclude _id from response spread). Same fix for POST /api/categories.
Fix brute-force lockout: strip IP from identifier (use email only) OR configure ProxyHeadersMiddleware + trust X-Forwarded-For so a single client IP is seen.
Fix GET /api/ 404 by re-ordering router include or moving the '/' route before include_router.
(Optional design) Replace native datetime-local pickers on /auctions/new with shadcn Calendar for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 998 lines — should be split into modules (auth, auctions, bids, admin, sockets) for maintainability.
CORS_ORIGINS env var is set to '*' in .env but not used anywhere; server.py hard-codes allow_origins to [FRONTEND_URL, 'http://localhost:3000']. Remove the unused env var or wire it up.

Global asyncio.Lock (_bid_lock) serializes ALL bids across ALL auctions. For a busy platform this becomes a bottleneck — should be per-auction lock (e.g., a dict of locks keyed by auction_id) or use MongoDB findOneAndUpdate atomic operation.
auction_ticker runs every 3s and iterates over full collections; for scale, add index-backed queries `find({status:'upcoming', start_time:{$lte: now}})` instead of loading and filtering in Python.
POST /api/feedback and POST /api/categories return spread of MongoDB doc that includes ObjectId `_id` — must exclude _id.
brute-force identifier uses request.client.host which is unreliable behind ingress/proxy.
@api.get('/') added after include_router — route unreachable (dead code).
test_credentials: admin@bidbridge.com / Admin@12345 · seller@bidbridge.com / Seller@12345 · bidder@bidbridge.com / Bidder@12345 — all validated.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin/seller/bidder users, 8 categories, and 4 demo auctions on startup. Verified. Backend_test.py also creates a few TEST_ prefixed users and auctions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers auth, auction CRUD, bidding, watchlist, notifications, feedback, admin. All 3 failing tests reflect genuine backend bugs (not test bugs). After main agent fixes: (1) feedback ObjectId leak, (2) brute-force identifier, (3) root route ordering — re-run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v` and expect 17/17. Socket.IO real-time bid propagation confirmed working via UI (bid $100->$110 updated in place with pulse animation).

rca of the issue.feedback_500: server.py line 871 `return {'id': str(res.inserted_id), **{k:v for k,v in doc.items()}}` — after `await db.feedback.insert_one(doc)`, motor mutates `doc` to include the newly-created `_id: ObjectId(...)`. Spreading doc.items() puts an ObjectId under the `_id` key which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize (raises TypeError: ObjectId is not iterable). Fix: `**{k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k != '_id'}`.
rca of the issue.brute_force_bypass: Backend runs behind multiple ingress pods. Each backend replica sees `request.client.host` = the immediate hop (an ingress pod IP). Observed values: 10.219.2.4 and 10.219.2.7. Because the login_attempts identifier is `{ip}:{email}`, load-balancing distributes attempts across at least two identifiers, and neither reaches the MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 threshold quickly. Verified: 7 sequential wrong-password logins all returned 401 (never 429), with DB showing two rows for the same email under two different IPs.
rca of the issue.root_404: server.py line 977 `fastapi_app.include_router(api)` is called BEFORE line 990-992 `@api.get('/')`. FastAPI snapshots router routes at include time, so the '/' handler is never mounted. Either move include_router to end of file, or define root route earlier.
